video_summary.overall_goal: Test bill reset and settings toggle workflow in a bill-splitting application
video_summary.description: User opens the bill management menu, resets all expenses, then opens currency settings and toggles tax and discount calculation switches. All interactions complete successfully with visual feedback.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Bily main bill-splitting screen showing Global Bill ($0.00), Balance Per User list (Ygb, Tfc), and Expenses section. Header with menu icon and action button visible.
visible_ui_elements: Balance Per User section with two users (Ygb, Tfc)
steps.system_response: Context menu appears with options: Modify Bill, Reset Bill, Settings

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Menu is now open with three options visible: Modify Bill, Reset Bill, Settings
steps.system_response: Confirmation dialog appears: 'Are You Sure? This will remove all expenses.'
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog overlay with cancel and reset buttons

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Confirmation dialog showing 'Are You Sure? This will remove all expenses.' with Cancel and Reset buttons
steps.system_response: Dialog closes, all expenses are cleared from Expenses section. Balance Per User shows $0.00 for both users.
steps.visual_feedback: Dialog fade-out, Expenses section becomes empty

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Main bill screen now shows cleared state: Global Bill $0.00, Balance Per User with both users at $0.00, empty Expenses section. Settings panel appears at bottom with Currency (US Dollar $) and options for Taxes and Discount.
visible_ui_elements: Settings panel overlay showing Currency, Taxes toggle, Discount toggle
steps.system_response: Taxes toggle changes state (appears to toggle on or off, visual state changes)
steps.visual_feedback: Toggle switch animates, color change indicates state

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Settings panel still visible, Taxes toggle shows new state (14.375% label visible). User interacts with Discount toggle.
steps.system_response: Discount toggle changes state, visual feedback indicates toggle activation

steps.what_screen_is_visible: Main bill screen returns to normal view with settings panel closed. Shows Global Bill $0.00, cleared Balance Per User list (both users $0.00), empty Expenses section, Add Expense button visible.
steps.system_response: UI returns to default bill dashboard view with all settings applied
steps.visual_feedback: Settings overlay fades, main content visible
steps.intent_task: Complete settings configuration and return to main dashboard

overall_flow: User opens bill management menu from main dashboard
User selects 'Reset Bill' to clear all expenses
User confirms reset action via confirmation dialog
All expenses are cleared; balances reset to zero
User accesses settings panel and toggles tax calculation
Settings are applied and panel closes, returning to main dashboard
human_readable_step_summary: Open bill management menu by tapping three-dot icon
Confirm reset action in dialog (all expenses will be removed)
Toggle tax calculation setting in currency settings panel
Toggle discount calculation setting in currency settings panel
Settings panel closes and bill dashboard shows cleared state
